title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition — Paper Submission
summary: Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren, and Jian Sun submitted 'Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition' on December 10, 2015. The paper presents a residual learning framework that reformulates layers as learning residual functions with reference to layer inputs and reports experiments with residual networks up to 152 layers on ImageNet.
significance: A documented deep-learning research milestone for residual learning, recorded at the paper-submission level without treating the submission date as an invention, development-start, or system-birth date.

verification.note: The authors' arXiv record establishes the title, author list, December 10 2015 first-submission date, and the paper's residual-learning method description. The CVPR 2016 open-access proceedings independently corroborate the title, authors, and residual-learning paper. This candidate records only the dated paper-submission milestone. It does not infer an invention date, development-start date, software-release date, universal priority, institutional geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.
